definitions.catch_rate: share of shelves empty the next day that were in the top-20 alert set
definitions.false_alarm_rate: share of top-20 alerts whose shelf was not empty the next day
definitions.rule: alert when the shelf was empty on the same weekday one or two weeks before the target day; rank by stockout buckets in the last 14 days
definitions.lazy_guess: observed sales on the same weekday one week earlier
